Metadata.title: Potodulu — Photobooth Experience
Metadata.description: A fast, playful photobooth experience built for online and offline booths.

Footer.tagline: Photo experiences for online, offline, and remote group booths.

Hero.headline: Try Online Photobooth
Hero.supporting: Guest demo in your browser. No account required. Temporary browser storage only.

Features.title: Everything a photo session needs
Features.subtitle: From countdown to share-ready output — without friction.

capture.title: Fast capture
capture.description: Live preview, smooth countdown, and touch-friendly triggers.

frame.title: Frames & layouts
frame.description: Flexible frame composition for a consistent brand experience.

share.title: Share-ready output
share.description: Results ready to download, print, or push to the session gallery.

Experience.title: Online & Offline, one experience
Experience.subtitle: Experience-driven architecture — the mode changes, the product feel stays.

online.title: Online Booth
online.description: Remote sessions in the browser. Device cameras become the booth.

offline.title: Offline Booth
offline.description: Built for physical booth hardware. Local flow stays fast when the network dips.

Cta.title: Ready to try the guest demo?
Cta.subtitle: Browser only. No account. Temporary storage inside your device.

Demo.title: Guest Demo
Demo.subtitle: Validate the full online photobooth flow without a backend.

TryWarning.pageSubtitle: This guest demo runs entirely in your browser. Opening this page clears previous demo storage.
TryWarning.title: Temporary browser storage
TryWarning.description: This demo stores your work temporarily inside your browser. Opening /try clears old demo data. Storage is also cleared after download or cancel. Browser cleanup may remove work at any time.

TryLayout.title: Select layout
TryLayout.subtitle: Choose how your photos will be arranged.

TryCamera.title: Capture
TryCamera.subtitle: Pick a countdown, the clip records for that duration, then the still is taken on flash.
TryCamera.permissionHint: Allow camera access to start the live preview.
TryCamera.countdownHint: The clip records for this duration.
TryCamera.mirrorHint: Live preview and captured results follow this setting.
TryCamera.rotateToLandscape: Rotate your device to landscape mode to use the photobooth.

TryFrame.title: Choose frame
TryFrame.subtitle: Frames are metadata-driven. Assets can be added later.

TrySelect.title: Choose photos
TrySelect.subtitle: Assign photos to slots, adjust crop position, pick a frame, and apply a filter — all on this page.
TrySelect.pickHint: Tap a photo to fill the selected slot.
TrySelect.repositionHint: Tap a slot, then drag the photo to adjust the crop.
TrySelect.slotOccupied: Clear the slot before dropping another photo.
TrySelect.missingLayout: Layout missing. Go back and select one.
TrySelect.filtersHint: One filter for every photo in the final photobooth still.

TryPreview.title: Preview
TryPreview.subtitle: Live-photo preview. Download each asset individually.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This route wandered off the booth. Let’s get you back.

server.title: Something broke
server.description: The booth tripped over a cable. Try again in a moment.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.description: We’re polishing the booth. Check back shortly.
